# MatEnforcer

> MatEnforcer is management software for Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ) academies, built by a practitioner. It runs an academy the way a BJJ gym already works: belts and stripes, mat hours, separate Gi and No-Gi ranks, open mats and drop-ins. It has not launched yet. This site is a coming-soon page with a launch mailing list.

Status: in development, not yet available. None of the features below are live. Everything listed is planned for the first release.

Who it is for: owners, instructors and front-desk staff of BJJ academies, including academies with several locations and academies in affiliation teams. Members use a free app.

## Pricing

- $150 per month flat. Same price for 30 members or 300 members.
- 90-day free trial, no card required.
- MatEnforcer takes no cut of member payments. Academies bill members through their own processor, or Stripe set up through the Academy account.
- Text AI is included. The voice front desk is a $10 per month add-on, or bring your own AI at no extra charge.
- The first five founding academies pay $50 per month for the first year after the trial, then $150 flat.
- The first five founding academies also get free additional locations for life.
- More than one location: the first location is $150 per month flat, the second location is $100 per month, and the third and each additional location after that is $50 per month.

## Planned features

### On the mat

- Check-in at a counter kiosk, by QR code or by name, with a class schedule, class booking with waitlists and booking windows, and mat hours counted separately for Gi and No-Gi. Members can also check in by GPS from the member app.
- Bulk check-in: mark a whole class present at once.
- A coach's mat view: a round timer and the members in class, with rank and progress to promotion.
- Promotion rules: the academy chooses how much attendance counts. Stripe and belt eligibility can weigh mat hours, attendance, time in grade, syllabus check-offs and instructor assessments, on separate Gi and No-Gi ladders. Eligibility alerts the instructor and never promotes on its own. Belt testing is optional. Members see their own progress toward the next belt or stripe as a percent.
- Achievements: badges for attendance streaks and mat-hour milestones, and optional leaderboards.
- Curriculum: technique libraries and recorded classes in the member app.
- Open mats, seminars and private lessons, booked and paid in the app.
- In-house tournaments: brackets, mat schedules and scoring, with results written back to each member's record.

### Running the academy

- A daily needs-attention list of members and prospects to act on, each with a plain reason.
- A member hub for everyday tasks on one profile, and bulk actions on a filtered group of members.
- A roster with belts and stripes, federation membership numbers and expiry dates, and roles for owner, admin, instructor, front desk and student.
- Online sign-up and digital waivers, including a guardian signing for a child.
- Dues and drop-ins through the academy's own payment processor: freezes, pauses, family billing, class packs, trials, promo codes and renewal reminders.
- Failed-payment recovery: a backup payment method on file and a member wallet for account credit, plus update links, scheduled retries and staff alerts.
- Door access tied to membership status: doors open for members in good standing and stay shut when a payment fails or a membership is frozen or cancelled.
- Instructor pay reports, expense tracking, and reports on revenue, attendance and churn, exportable as CSV.
- Multiple locations, each with its own schedule, kiosk and staff. Locations can share one academy website, or each can have its own website with a unique domain.
- Import from an academy's current software by CSV export, with a guided checklist, and export of all data at any time.

### Messages and growth

- Automatic emails and texts for inactivity, milestones and failed payments, plus broadcasts. Retention triggers are pattern-based: a drop against the member's own usual attendance, not just a fixed number of days away.
- Owner-set automations: a trigger (days away, trial attended, waiver expiring) and an action (send a message, tell staff, create a task).
- Class reminders and cancellation notices, a two-way text inbox, and email sent from the academy's own domain. Members add a booked class to their calendar, get a nudge when a trial is about to expire, and get asked for a review after class.
- An AI front desk: answers texts, calls and social messages, books trials into the schedule and hands off to staff when it should. Text is included; the voice phone line is a $10 per month add-on, or connect your own AI at no extra charge.
- Social publishing: publish and schedule posts to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and X, see how they perform, and answer DMs from WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram in one inbox. A DM from a stranger creates a prospect in the pipeline.
- A leads pipeline from first contact to member, and member referrals.

### Online

- A free installable member app, customized for each academy, with passkey sign-in and a training journal.
- A website for each academy, on its own domain, with a live schedule, staff profiles and lineage, and a blog the academy can turn on or off.
- A gear shop, affiliation team support, a content API and webhooks.
- Five languages at launch: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French and German, with Japanese to follow.
